headline: Mod installs get easier, with fixes for movement, sound and underwater visibility
summary: Development builds gain a mod index, dependency installs, automatic updates with rollback and setup sharing; that work has not yet been run on Windows, macOS or Android (#161). Ratchet can run diagonally more consistently, Windows sound gaps are addressed, and swimming on Pokitaru no longer reveals rooms beneath the sea floor (#168, #188, #194). Contributors gain an Object Viewer and free camera, while Enhanced Vulkan gains Forward+ local lighting; experimental light editing remains disabled by default (#195, #196). Going Commando's USA v1.01 native port remains an unmerged draft: it builds and runs, but is not yet playable, ship controls are incomplete and most menus are untested (#191).
highlights: Android Enhanced graphics switches to Arm ASR on Qualcomm GPUs; the drawer adds motion blur, colour correction, texture upscaling and reset controls (#165, #183).
Windows fixes restore Orxon's electric barrier strands and correct blue explosion debris on Batalia (#171, #178).
Add to Steam was tested on Linux; Windows and macOS still need manual checks, and Flatpak Steam is refused (#184).
Mod SDK 1.11.0 was released: mods gain their own data folder and can identify the current save slot (#172).
Audio replacement is proposed in unmerged #164. Cross-region co-op, separate saves and host takeover remain a draft, not ready for review or merge (#166).
The day's 138,618 added and 49,327 deleted lines are dominated by the upstream RAC1 import: #160 accounts for 111,618 additions and 47,520 deletions.
